title: SMetric: Rethink LLM Scheduling for Serving Agents with Balanced Session-centric Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2607.08565v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM scheduling is critical to serving, yet how well existing designs fit agentic serving--where agents, not humans, issue the requests--remains unclear. Agents shift the workload in two ways: they consume many more tokens than humans, so the cluster must provide high throughput (TPS) at low latency; and their requests reuse far more KV\$ than chat.   Existing schedulers still trade off load balance against KV\$ reuse: cache-aware schedulers may crowd requests onto the few instances caching the KV\$, leaving the rest idle, while balanced schedulers may lose the opportunity for reuse, which is costly at a high reuse ratio. We thus present two key insights: (1) with a global-tier KV\$ store, pursuing load balance need not compromise KV\$ reuse, though the slower global tier must be used with care; and (2) given the agent's intra-session locality, routing requests by their sessions can balance the load with high KV\$ reuse. translated_title: SMetric：重新思考面向智能体服务的LLM调度——均衡的以会话为中心的调度
translated_abstract: LLM调度对推理服务至关重要，然而现有设计在多大程度上适用于智能体化服务——即由智能体而非人类发出请求——仍不明确。智能体从两方面改变了工作负载：其一，它们消耗的token数量远超人类，因此集群必须在低延迟下提供高吞吐量（TPS）；其二，与聊天场景相比，其请求对KV缓存的重用要多得多。现有调度器仍在负载均衡与KV缓存重用之间进行权衡：缓存感知调度器可能将请求都挤到少数缓存了KV的实例上，使其余实例闲置；而负载均衡调度器则可能错失重用机会，在高重用率下代价高昂。为此，本文提出两个关键洞见：（1）借助全局层KV缓存存储，追求负载均衡无需以牺牲KV缓存重用为代价，尽管较慢的全局层必须谨慎使用；（2）鉴于智能体请求的会话内局部性，按会话来路由请求可以在实现负载均衡的同时保持较高的KV缓存重用率。
tldr: 本文提出SMetric，通过全局层KV缓存存储与以会话为中心的请求路由，在服务智能体工作负载时同时实现负载均衡与高KV缓存重用，兼顾高吞吐与低延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SMetric, which achieves both load balancing and high KV cache reuse for agentic LLM serving through a global-tier KV store and session-centric request routing.
